RuntimeConfigWebpackPlugin.summary.en:
Merges this bundle's runtime configuration into
`lynx.__runtime_configs__`, then shallow-freezes it.

Apply it to the host bundle only. Lazy and external bundles consume the
configuration injected by the host.
RuntimeConfigWebpackPlugin.summary.text:
将当前 bundle 的运行时配置合并到
`lynx.__runtime_configs__` 中，然后对其进行浅冻结。

仅将其应用于宿主 bundle。lazy bundle 和 external bundle 会使用宿主注入的配置。

RuntimeConfigWebpackPlugin.apply.summary.en: The entry point of a webpack plugin.

RuntimeConfigWebpackPluginOptions.summar.en:
Page-scoped runtime configuration contributed by a bundle.

The plugin deliberately leaves configuration keys and values to the DSL
that consumes them.
RuntimeConfigWebpackPluginOptions.summar.text:
由 bundle 提供的页面级运行时配置。

该插件有意不限定配置的 key 和 value，交由使用它们的 DSL 决定。
